findings.issue: Both matched capture pairs sample only PUSH_AT, the one instant where the bars are exactly scaleY(1) and the panel is exactly translate 0 regardless of duration, easing or travel distance. They prove the static composition is unchanged (arc, spectrum, blur, panel height, bottom overshoot, four-stop mask, per-theme alpha) and prove nothing about motion. $travel (1.45) and the shared $aurora-ease are exactly what the extraction re-expressed in the new $viewport unit, and tests/aurora-transition.test.ts pins only RISE_MS/RISE_PUSH_AT for internal TS-vs-CSS agreement, reading both from the current source. 'Unchanged to the eye' across the growth curve and the travel-out is therefore unverified.

The reduced-motion still for the sweep parks the band at 70cqw, leaving only its magenta tail on screen (about a quarter of the band's width, two of six spectrum stops, hard-clipped at the viewport's right edge). It meets the literal bar (legible static state, not blank, not hidden) but shows the least informative frame of the variant; the rise's still, by contrast, shows the whole arc and the full spectrum.

The clause 'the frame's existing glow wake behavior (T-011) is unaffected in every motion mode' is not judged: app/lab/frame.tsx is outside the permitted input set and no capture isolates the wake across motion modes. The AC8 focus captures show the wake lit under focus, which is consistent with it being intact but does not establish invariance. Routed to verify.

'app/components/copy-prompt.tsx is not modified' is a diff claim, not a property of the artifacts, and is not judgeable from the input set. The fullpage captures show experiments 01 and 02 rendering an identical Copy prompt affordance, which is consistent with it. Routed to verify. Everything else in AC 3 is met: number, slug, title, summary, stack, fonts, colors (token references only), prompt and component are all present and the registry type is unchanged.

pnpm test, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit and pnpm build green at the evidence SHA, and the diff-confinement clause, require execution output that is not in the permitted input set. Not judged here; routed to verify as a quoted attestation.

The prompt is a build spec for the shipped ROUTE transition (capture-phase click interceptor, router.push, 'attach no listener and render nothing' under reduced motion), not for the miniature harness the lab frame actually shows, and its reduced-motion path is the opposite of what the experiment displays (a parked still). This satisfies AC 4's plain reading ('an agent could build the effect from it') and every quantity in it matches the code exactly, so it is reported as an ambiguity in the bar rather than a defect: 'the effect' vs 'the experiment' should be disambiguated for the next prompt.

The gesture toggle stays live during a run: the running.current guard covers go() only, so pressing rise/sweep mid-run swaps the gesture layer under itself and leaves a half-played run replaced by a fresh one starting from its from-state.

On the dark theme the miniature's only separation from the frame's ground is its 1px border: box-shadow 0 16px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18) is invisible against a near-black ground, so the 'lifts the miniature off the frame's glow ground' the comment claims does not happen there and window and ground read as one plane.

At rest the mini viewport's lower ~45% is empty on the base page, so on the lab index experiment 02 reads as a near-blank panel until someone interacts, where experiment 01 fills its frame and announces itself immediately. Composition note only: the gate decision of 2026-08-15 forbids an auto-loop on frame wake, so the inertness at rest is a deliberate consequence, not a behavior gap.
